method: Exporter rules read from video-studio/release/manifest.json and tools/release/export.mjs (read-only). The exporter reads committed files only, so a copy of it was run in a scratch folder against this worktree's tracked plus untracked files (ignoring .gitignore) with --report-only; its staged-file list and banned-word scan feed the 'exporter_*' fields. Nothing was committed.
rc2_comparison: RC2 (a644abd, source 27b2d75) contains none of the files below: no library/fixtures, no grade.mjs, no engine/src/kit/ugc, no ugc-* motion entry (243 moves, 0 ugc), none of the 9 sounds, no tulvo stills or take-5 files.
exporter_findings: Committed as is, the exporter would stop: 41 banned-word hits in 8 files, of which 24 in library/fixtures/ugc-01/card.json, 1 in library/fixtures/ugc-01/README.md and 6 in .damex/** (notes). The other 10 hits (library/references, knowledge/craft/07-sound.md) are in this worktree's tree whatever this branch does.
release/manifest.json has no rule for library/fixtures or .damex. Add both to 'exclude' (fixtures hold privateStudy-only references).

Included and allowed once committed: the 9 sounds with their index entries and CREDITS.md, kit.json, the three kit/ugc moves and their gallery code, grade.mjs, the mix.py and synth.py changes and the tests.
Not shipped: the 3 motion preview mp4 (library/motion/*.mp4), the preset (brands/tulvo), the ugc-01 and product-motion-02 jobs (engine/src/jobs, jobs), all fixture stills (jobs).
